evidence.title: Cohere Releases Parse 5 (parse-v5.0): A 2.3B Vision Language Model That Turns Enterprise Documents Into Markdown

summary: Cohere has introduced Parse 5, a new 2.3 billion‑parameter vision‑language model built to process enterprise documents and output them in markdown format. The tool is aimed at simplifying document ingestion and formatting for business workflows.
title: Cohere Launches Parse 5, a 2.3B Vision‑Language Model that Converts Enterprise Docs to Markdown
